tokens.v: A test scenario exists beside the actual one, initialized for the item.

before.text: A test scenario exists beside the actual one, initialized for the item.

tokens.v: A scenario is a separate copy of the plan. Demand and planned orders entered or generated in a test scenario touch nothing in the actual one, which keeps the real orders. When the test looks right, its planned orders are copied to the actual scenario, and its special demand is copied by hand.
